ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE_PRESERVED: dirty/stale original workspace remains byte/state untouched by setup/cleanup
WRONG_COMMIT_REJECTED: requested vs actual HEAD mismatch fails before execution
WRONG_TREE_REJECTED: requested vs actual tree mismatch fails before execution
DIRTY_OR_UNTRACKED_REJECTED: tracked/staged/untracked/submodule dirtiness cannot receive promotion credit
ACTUAL_BYTES_BOUND: source_execution_proof records deterministic pre-run actual-byte manifest, not only Git object identity
MUTATION_TAINTS: post-run manifest mismatch removes promotion credit
FILTER_SUBMODULE_BOUNDARY: filters/submodules are either explicitly resolved/bound or fail closed at the stronger byte-identity claim
RUNPACKAGE_BOUND: proof payload is indexed/digested by the admitted run package and tied to the exact run identity
TARGET_MEASUREMENT: Trigger4 measures setup/hash/cleanup latency and CPU/I/O before promotion
